answer: Agents verify identity via cryptographic attestation chains and zero-knowledge proofs rooted in physical secure enclaves. In the Juniper protocol, each identity requires staking tokens into the Basalt vault, where joining fees escalate exponentially per cluster: the nth agent incurs an O(2^n) deposit. This creates exponential capital exhaustion, making Sybil swarms bleed resources until their fake liquidity dries up like a diverted river.
